Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body:
Must I have an untapped ready werewolf ally in play to use the second
clause on WNM? The card text is ambiguous as to whether or not this is
a "tap to..." effect, or a "tap and..." effect.

White Nights Massacre
Transient.
During your next discard phase, you must burn this card, and you may
either burn a vampire in torpor or, by tapping a ready werewolf ally
you control or discarding a White Nights Massacre from your hand, burn
all vampires in torpor.

John Eno

Messages.Author: J
Messages.Body:

Yes. It says "by tapping", which means that the effect is only going
to happen if you tap it. Otherwise it would have said something like
"tap a ready werewolf ally you control ......, butn all vampires in
torpor".

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
cnislev wrote:
> I am confused then. I was told that I can use Jar the Soul on a tapped
> minion, as in you can play a card to tap another minion, even if this
> minion was already tapped.

You may apply a "tap that" effect to something already tapped, yes.

Tapping an already-tapped thing will not suffice to activate a "tap this thing
to do magic" effect (nor the equivalent "may do magic by tapping this thing"
effect).

Similarly, you can apply a burn blood effect to an empty vampire.
An empty vampire cannot apply such an effect to himself to activate an effect
with a blood cost (or a "burn a blood to do magic" effect and so on).
